en.headline: School bus rear-ends KMB double-decker on New Clear Water Bay Road, eight injured
en.dek: A school bus carrying students collided with the rear of a 290A bus near Choi Wan Estate around 4pm on Tuesday, leaving eight people with minor injuries including two pupils.
body: Police said a school bus travelling down the slope on New Clear Water Bay Road towards Wong Tai Sin failed to stop in time and struck the rear of a Kowloon Motor Bus route 290A double-decker near the White Rainbow House stop at Choi Wan Estate at about 4pm on Tuesday.

Eight people suffered minor injuries, including two primary school pupils on the school bus. All were taken to United Christian Hospital in Kwun Tong while conscious. The school bus driver, a 53-year-old man surnamed Leung, reported feeling dizzy. KMB confirmed four passengers on its bus were hurt and said staff had visited them.

The Leisure and Cultural Services Department and the school involved, St Paul's Church Kowloon Bay Kei Lok Primary School, said teachers went to the scene. The two injured pupils had no visible wounds and were sent for checks on medical advice; other students were transferred to another bus and returned home safely. Transport Department closed some lanes near Choi Hing Lane, causing congestion.

zh.headline: 新清水灣道校巴落斜撞九巴車尾 八人受輕傷包括兩學童
zh.dek: 週二下午約4時，一輛接載學童的校巴在彩雲邨對開往黃大仙方向疑收刾不及，撞向停駐的290A線九巴車尾，造成八人輕傷，包括兩名小學生。
body: 警方指，今日下午約4時，一輛校巴沿新清水灣道落斜往黃大仙方向行駛，駐至彩雲邨白虹樓巴士站對開時，疑收刾不及撞及前方一輛290A線雙層巴士車尾。
車禍導致八人受輕傷，包括校巴上兩名小學生。全部傷者清醒由救護車送往觀塘聯合醫院治理。校巴梁姓司機（53歲）報稱頭暈。九巴確認車上四名乘客受傷，已派員慰問。
涉事聖公會九龍灣基樂小學表示，已即時安排老師到場跟進。兩名受傷學童無表面傷，按醫護建議送院檢查；其他學童經檢查後已由另一輛校巴接送安全回家。運輸署因事件封閉新清水灣道近彩興里部分行車線，交通繁忙。
